goal: Improve held-out attack-family detection using causal file-change history with low normal-task false positives.
status: Fixed development experiment; existing inspected corpus, not a blind test
features: Existing 26 stable features versus the same 26 plus 8 unlink features: current log-count and known directory-scope log-count, trailing log-count and active-second fraction for 5/30/60 seconds.
time_rule: Score after current one-second bucket closes. A W-second window includes current bucket and preceding W-1 seconds; future rows never affect earlier features. Warm-up is 59 elapsed seconds per session.
scope: Each accepted session's monitored cgroup. Do not infer same-task or process-lineage relationships. No state reset at technique, label or workload boundaries. A gap without a recorded unlink event contributes zero observed unlink activity, not proof of complete process inactivity.
inputs: The existing six accepted single-session NPZs and corresponding closed compressed captures. Validate exact bucket/session/label/technique joins and raw/collector unlink counts. Refuse outside-NPZ unlink events before deriving features.
split: First four sessions in stable ID order for training; fifth for calibration; sixth for test. Keep the prior dataset order and untouched artifacts.
normal_only_model: IsolationForest300, seed42, max_samples auto, max_features1.0, bootstrapfalse, contaminationauto, n_jobs1. Fit only training normals whose entire 60-second history contains no positive attack bucket.
held_out_groups: Separate diagnostic RandomForest300, seed42, sqrt, balanced for each existing four semantic groups. Exclude target attacks and every retained training row whose 60-second history contains a target-group attack bucket.
calibration: Only fifth-session normal rows with warm-up complete and no positive attack bucket in their trailing 60-second history. Shared normal_cutoff with target FPR0.005; fail if no eligible normals remain.
test: Sixth-session warmed-up rows. Do not purge test normals using preceding attack labels. Group diagnostics report all eligible normals plus that group's positives.
comparison: Baseline26 and augmented34 use identical eligible row IDs, order, models and threshold-selection rule. Report excluded counts, TP/FN/FP/TN and per-technique metrics. Do not tune parameters or thresholds from test results.
limitations: Unlink hooks are attempts, not successful deletion. Scope uses nonzero device/directory-inode pairs; partial basename is not a full path. Sixty-second features do not establish arbitrary-sleep coverage; existing verified-lineage memory is a separate experiment. No role or measured CPU features exist yet.
deployment: No exports, model replacement, live alarm-policy change or automatic recurring checks. Fresh role-labeled normal controls and fresh held-out-family validation are required before promotion.
